note: Labelled example phrasings, used to decide whether a description is something VITA covers. An absolute similarity threshold does not work for this: measured against this corpus, Gemini embeddings put unrelated text ('my cat scratched my laptop') at 0.55 and a genuine self-harm disclosure at 0.59, so no cut-off separates them. What does work is nearest-class - compare the description against examples of what IS covered and examples of what is NOT, and see which side it lands on. These are deliberately written the way patients speak, not the way clinicians do.
